verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Fathom's API, webhooks, SDKs, MCP server, pricing features and SSO/SCIM. Nothing in it says whether meeting data is used to train AI models, offers an org-level opt-out, or states a SOC 2 or HIPAA posture. Privacy and compliance posture is a fair axis for a meeting-recording SaaS, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.
